import pandas as pd

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot from long format to wide format
# Group by city_id, city_name, year and pivot indicator_id to columns
pivot_df = df.pivot(index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'], columns='indicator_id', values='value')

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Ensure proper column order: city_id, city_name, year, then all indicators
cols_to_keep = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in pivot_df.columns if col not in cols_to_keep]
pivot_df = pivot_df[cols_to_keep + indicator_cols]

# Fill any missing values (empty cells) with empty string
pivot_df = pivot_df.applymap(lambda x: '' if pd.isna(x) else x)

# Write to output CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (pandas handles quoting automatically)
pivot_df.to_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', index=False)
